title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
We are looking for a proactive Sales Support Specialist to join our team in Rio de Janeiro

Category

Sales Support

Location

Rio de Janeiro, Brasil

Deadline

Reference

RCP-

A world-class company


Welltec is a fast-growing, global technology company that develops and provides efficient, hi-tech solutions for the energy industry. We are active in 25 countries with more than 950 employees from over 60 different nations. This contributes to our unique atmosphere with a global dimension yet a strong foothold at the various bases.

Our technologies and services are for the global market but our solutions are local and tailored to each client. To achieve this, we depend on highly trained and motivated employees.

Our policy is to hire locally and work globally. We therefore recruit where we operate and train employees at the Welltec Academy supplemented with external training from third parties as needed.

The global dimension offers a range of opportunities for those who are motivated by a challenging and multicultural environment where employee come from very different backgrounds but with a common goal to collaborate and succeed.

The position


You will be the support person in Sales Brazil. You will be responsible for the daily support commercial staff with all administrative tasks.

Key responsibilities

  • Assist the entire team in meeting applicable sales requirements.
  • Be the LAM focal point for CRM, Xaitporter, and good news.
  • Monitor completion (WCS) and intervention (WIS) revenue.
  • Invoice products and services.
  • Receive the PO, monitor manufacturing, and ship equipment to customers.
  • Conduct the local content certification process.
  • Control contracts, their consumption, and related information.
  • Knowledge management.
  • Register and maintain Welltec's account on client/institution platforms.
  • Assist in sales events.
  • Support quality demands (audits, non-conformities).
  • Create reports.
  • Implement process and system improvements.

The candidate


We are looking for a colleague who wants to be part of a small, informal team, who is always ready to help each other. It is also important that you like working in an environment where things are constantly changing. In addition, you must have:

  • Minimum 3 years' experience from a similar position
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Professional in English

And finally, you must be:

  • Service minded
  • Curious and structured
  • Proactive and good at following up

What we offer


Working with Welltec means challenges and personal development in a demanding work environment. It is exciting, rewarding and a varied place to work. Welltec is an equal opportunities employer. We offer good career opportunities for the right candidate.

Also, Welltec offers a competitive compensation package, health and dental insurance, Wellhub, Prived Pension and life insurance.

The process


If you are interested and feel you match the qualifications for this position submit your resume and application.

Interviews will be held on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. When you apply, please specify which of our locations that you apply for. You can apply for multiple locations.

title: Paid Search Manager
description:
Position is Remote (Canada, or Latin / South America)

No agencies please

Maximus ) is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine company that empowers individuals to achieve their physical and cognitive peak through precision telehealth care. We are a high-growth, profitable company tailored to ambitious people who refuse to settle for average. We are backed by top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly technical Paid Search & YouTube Manager who thrives on intent capture, granular data analysis, and scientific rigor. In this role, you will be instrumental in transitioning our SEM and YouTube operations in-house, taking ownership of these critical high-intent channels to help us scale.

You will work directly with the Director of Paid Media to manage, execute, and optimize campaigns primarily on Google (Search & YouTube) and Microsoft (Bing). This role requires an individual who embodies "curiosity"—you never accept "that's just the way it is" or rely solely on automated bidding strategies without oversight. Instead, you dive deep into the Search Query Reports to understand the "why" behind performance. You will be expected to work transparently, sharing work queues and mid-stream insights to ensure alignment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own Campaign Execution: Take end-to-end ownership of campaign setup, management, and optimization across Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Discovery/Demand Gen) and Microsoft Ads. You will lead the transition of these responsibilities from our current agency partners

  • Master Intent & Keywords: Meticulously manage keyword strategy. You will move beyond simple broad match reliance to build robust negative keyword lists, structure high-intent ad groups, and maximize Quality Score to improve efficiency.

  • Drive YouTube Performance: Treat YouTube as a direct-response performance channel. You will collaborate with the creative team to iterate on video hooks, pacing, and CTAs based on retention rates and conversion data, not just vanity view metrics.

  • Scientific A/B Testing: Rigorous A/B testing of headlines, descriptions, and extensions, and landing pages.

  • Master Attribution: Utilize internal analytics and multi-touch attribution (MTA) tools alongside platform data to triangulate performance.

  • Analyze & Iterate: Assist in the set-up and evaluation geo holdout tests to prove incrementality.

  • Work Transparently: Maintain visible work queues and rigorous reporting standards. You will prepare data for weekly paid media performance reviews to discuss budget shifts, CPA targets, and anomalies.

Qualifications

  • Platform Expertise: Deep, hands-on mastery of Google Ads and Microsoft Advertising is non-negotiable. You must have a track record of scaling direct-response accounts in a D2C environment.

  • Demand Gen / Youtube Experience: Proven experience managing YouTube for conversions (VAC/Demand Gen), not just brand awareness. You understand how to buy YouTube traffic that converts.

  • Tech Stack: Proficiency with 1st party analytics tools is essential (GA4, Looker, Tableau or the like). Preferred experience with (or similar tools to) MTA platforms (Northbeam, Triple Whale), and experience implementing tracking pixels (GTM).

  • Resourcefulness: You are scrappy. You use the tools in front of you to prove value and are willing to track down the information you need rather than waiting for it to be handed to you.

  • Data-Driven Mindset: You base your decisions on numbers, ROAS/CAC targets, and data, not assumptions.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience in the Health & Wellness, Telehealth, or Biohacking space.

  • Proven success utilizing Google Scripts or automated rules to streamline optimizations.

  • Experience using AI tools (Claude, GoMarble, Gemini) for platform strategy and analysis.

World-Class Benefits

  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies - we manage energy, not time and promote work life flexibility

  • Exposure to top-tier leadership and a meritocratic culture where the best ideas win regardless of title.

  • Opportunity to work with a high-growth, science-backed brand changing the landscape of performance medicine.

  • Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on people's health and wellness

  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant growth opportunities

  • Full Suite Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance (for US & Canada based candidates only)

  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4 year employees)

  • Liquidity of options whenever available

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

Lean Six Sigma applications, to process redesign and improvement

Ability and desire to achieve Green Belt to Lean Bronze certification

Quem somos
Somos uma das maiores indústrias de alimentos do Brasil, líderes em massas e biscoitos, com mais de 70 anos de história. Marcas como Piraquê, Fit Food, Adria, Jasmine, Frontera, Vitarella, Isabela, Fortaleza, Richester, Puro Sabor, Finna e muitas outras fazem parte da vida de milhões de brasileiros. Temos mais de 17 mil colaboradores, 21 unidades no Brasil, 1 no Uruguai e 28 centros de distribuição, que garantem nossa presença no Brasil e em mais de 40 países pelo mundo.
Nossa atuação e cultura
Atuamos em diversos segmentos de alimentos, com um portfólio que inclui biscoitos, massas, farinhas, margarinas, bolos, snacks, torradas, chocolates, temperos, molhos, granolas, cookies, pasta de amendoim, panificação sem glúten e beneficiamento de grãos.
Valorizamos o respeito às pessoas e à diversidade, por acreditarmos que ela impulsiona resultados e transformações. Promovemos um ambiente inclusivo, onde todos são respeitados e reconhecidos por sua autenticidade e potencial, independentemente de idade, gênero, etnia ou orientação sexual.
Missão Do Cargo
Desempenhar, sob intensa supervisão, atividades de complexidade restrita relacionadas à manutenções elétricas preventiva e corretiva de máquinas e equipamentos de produção, bem como os serviços de montagem, teste, ajuste e modificação de circuitos elétricos relacionadas ao processo produtivo.
Responsibilities and assignments
Executar os serviços de manutenção preventiva, conforme padrões técnicos de manutenção (padrões de atividades críticas) e corretiva de máquinas, equipamentos, subestações e Sistemas Elétricos de Consumo (SEC);
Participar de reuniões de acompanhamento produtivo, TPM (manutenção preventiva total), pré-preventiva, entre outros;
Participar do tratamento de falha e quebra, propondo ações de bloqueio para as anomalias detectadas e executá-las;
Efetuar registros no software de gestão da manutenção sobre os atendimentos, com apropriação das horas trabalhadas, tarefas executadas, impactos sobre o processo e materiais utilizados;
Auxiliar a elaborar e treinar equipes de manutenção e operação, através das LPPs (lição ponto a ponto), relatar e tratar incidentes potenciais e riscos de segurança das atividades executadas;
Acompanhar e realizar serviços de montagem, teste, ajuste e possíveis modificações nas máquinas de produção, a fim de garantir pleno funcionamento no processo produtivo e melhorias em conjunto com a engenharia, fabricantes e operação.
Cumprir os requisitos de sustentabilidade, gestão da qualidade, segurança de alimentos, meio ambiente e segurança e saúde ocupacional.

No mínimo 6 meses de experiência na área ou áreas correlatas.

Diagramas elétricos, subestações, normas internas de segurança, boas práticas de manutenção, 5S, pacote Office, leitura e interpretação de desenho, noções de Noções de Noções de Food Defense e Food Fraud.

title: Implementations Lead
description:
The Company You'll Join


Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.

Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. 

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You'll Solve


As the Rio Implementations Lead, you will bridge the gap between technical execution and local team leadership. You will become an expert in private markets data and use that knowledge to implement our clients onto the Carta LPPA software, setting them up for long-term success.

As a technical specialist, you will: Directly interact with clients, managing implementation projects from post-sale requirements gathering to final system setup.

  • Extract the first tranches of data from documents and hand them off to the LPPA MDS team or the clients directly.
  • Train clients remotely over video conferencing and answer technical questions regarding LPPA software and setup via email or quick calls.
  • Establish strong customer relationships as the first post-sale service provider, inspiring long-term loyalty through a smooth onboarding process.
  • Work comfortably with data and business systems to develop training content for customers.
  • Think creatively to find software solutions for both equity and user problems.

As the local lead and future manager, you will be responsible for HR-based initiatives, including:

  • Overseeing onboarding, learning, and development for the local team.
  • Encouraging career growth and performance from both a professional and metrics-driven perspective.
  • Reviewing team and individual performance metrics to provide strategic recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Leading the execution of strategic initiatives, such as new processes, systems, and tools across the local department.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally to identify customer pain points and provide product improvement recommendations to ensure a "magical" customer experience.

The Team You'll Join


You will be the first service provider post-sale, joining a high-growth environment where you will eventually lead a team of Support Analysts and Specialists. You will work closely with product, engineering, and internal implementations leaders to constantly improve the onboarding experience and service models for new customer types.

About You

  • Communication: Fluent in English with strong written and verbal communication skills; able to articulate complex concepts clearly.
  • Organization: Highly organized with extreme attention to detail, capable of balancing multiple active projects with competing priorities.
  • Client-Centric: You care deeply about client services and exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise when communicating with customers under pressure.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficient in Excel and experienced with CRMs (preferably Salesforce).
  • Analytical Mindset: Able to independently identify problems, perform root cause analysis, and execute action plans.
  • Adaptability: Flexible, resilient, and comfortable dealing with uncertainties or ambiguous situations.
  • Leadership Traits: Proactive, ambitious, and a self-starter who takes ownership and empowers teammates to improve.
  • Experience (Plus): Knowledge of finance and accounting, or experience working at a high-growth software company.

title: Accounting & Payroll Specialist (QuickBooks, AP/AR) — Remote
description:
About the Client

PromptPeople is hiring for a fast-growing, high-performance services business supporting enterprise clients in the U.S. The company is scaling quickly and needs a finance operator who can take ownership of the day-to-day accounting workflow, keep the books clean, and bring structure to finance operations.

This is a hands-on role. We're looking for someone plug-and-play who can run end-to-end accounting tasks and keep things organized without constant oversight.

Why This Role Exists

The business needs someone to own finance operations end-to-end: AP, AR, invoicing in QuickBooks, payroll processing support, Excel-based reporting, and monthly close tasks. The goal is to reduce bottlenecks, keep finance predictable, and give leadership clean visibility.

What You'll Own (Responsibilities)

AP / AR + day-to-day accounting

  • Own accounts payable and receivable workflows end-to-end

  • Send invoices from QuickBooks, track collections, and follow up on aging AR

  • Process vendor bills, manage payments, and keep AP organized and accurate

  • Maintain clean records and documentation across transactions

Payroll coordination

  • Support payroll processing (including time adjustments, validations, and accuracy checks)

  • Maintain payroll-related documentation and ensure inputs are consistent and clean

Monthly reporting + close support

  • Prepare monthly financial reports for leadership

  • Support monthly close tasks and ensure books are updated and accurate

  • Keep reconciliations organized and up to date (bank and key accounts as needed)

Excel operations

  • Work comfortably in Excel (data cleanup, formatting, transposing datasets, building recurring reports)

  • Turn messy inputs into usable reporting for finance and leadership

Structure + workflow improvement (light systems)

  • Create simple checklists, templates, and repeatable workflows to reduce errors

  • Improve consistency and clarity across finance operations (without needing to "build a full finance org")

What Success Looks Like

First 30–60 days

  • Invoicing, collections, and bill pay are running consistently

  • Payroll adjustments and validations are handled reliably

  • Finance data is organized, up to date, and easy to audit internally

  • Leadership receives clean monthly reporting on time

3–6 months

  • Finance workflows are standardized with checklists and clear routines

  • AR/AP performance improves (fewer misses, cleaner tracking, faster follow-ups)

  • Monthly reporting and close tasks are predictable and low-friction

Requirements

  • Proven experience owning end-to-end accounting operations (AP + AR)

  • Comfortable running finance workflows inside QuickBooks (invoicing, bills, tracking)

  • Payroll processing experience (or strong exposure + ability to own validations/adjustments)

  • Strong Excel skills (including working with messy datasets; transposing / reporting)

  • High attention to detail and ability to work independently without babysitting

  • Excellent English communication (written + verbal)

Nice to Have

  • Experience in service businesses with payroll-heavy operations

  • Exposure to monthly close routines and basic accrual concepts

  • Familiarity with tools like Ramp or AP automation platforms

  • Multi-state / U.S. operations exposure (nice to have, not required)

Benefits

  • 100% remote

  • USD compensation

  • PTO (paid time off)

  • Local holidays

  • Direct work with the leadership team

  • High ownership and autonomy

  • Fast-paced environment with real impact

  • Growth opportunity as the company scales

title: Quality Engineer, Product QA
description:
Would you thrive in a role where technical rigor, quality assurance and cross-functional collaboration ensure flawless product execution?
Would you bring the critical thinking, discipline and problem‑solving mindset needed to drive continuous improvement across suppliers and internal execution sites?
Join our Quality Team
At Baker Hughes, Quality is essential to delivering safe, reliable and high-performing products. Our Product QA team ensures alignment with the Quality Management System (QMS), customer requirements and industry standards across internal sites and suppliers.
Partner with the best
As a Quality Engineer, Product QA (Suppliers Rotation), you will ensure technical requirements are implemented and verified across fabrication, assembly and validation processes. You will support audits, risk assessments, first article inspections, non-conformance management and continuous improvement.
As the Quality Engineer, Product QA (Suppliers Rotation) you will be responsible for:
Reviewing and improving product quality performance at execution sites.
Collaborating with Lean initiatives to enable process improvements and flawless execution.
Leading first article inspection (FAI) processes at suppliers and in‑house while using FMEA and other risk assessment tools.
Conducting product quality audits and performing regular Gemba walks.
Acting as a manufacturing risk assessor and mitigating identified execution risks.
Supporting and/or leading Go/No-Go reviews and facilitating pre‑production meetings.
Capturing, resolving and communicating operational Lessons Learned.
Promoting quality culture by conducting continuous improvement workshops.
Identifying, reviewing and addressing product non‑conformances with strategic corrective actions.
Implementing and monitoring product Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Communicating methods and approaches for solving complex quality issues.
Ensuring adherence to Product Line quality directives at fabrication sites.
Witnessing product inspections and qualification processes.
Registering and escalating critical observations as required.
Leading manufacturing review processes for new first articles with appropriate stakeholders.
Acting as a key enabler for implementing Non‑Conformance Management processes at extended sites.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Have a Bachelor's degree in Mechanical or Production Engineering.
Have fluent English skills.
Have knowledge of Brazilian customer quality requirements for subsea equipment fabrication (XT, Manifolds, Tooling).
Have previous experience in Quality Control for subsea equipment fabrication.
Have experience performing quality and product requirement audits.
Have knowledge of inspection processes and technical documentation analysis.
Have experience using quality tools such as A3, 8D, 5 Whys, Fishbone, FMEA, 5S and Lean Six‑Sigma.
Have strong leadership skills.
Have negotiation and influencing abilities with internal and external stakeholders.
Have the ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and quality requirements.
Have a Master's degree in a Quality-related discipline. (Desirable)
Have technical qualification or certification in Dimensional, Painting, Welding, NDT or Fabrication inspection. (Desirable)
Work in a way that works for you
We recognize that everyone is different and that the way in which people want to work and deliver at their best is different for everyone too. In this role, we can offer the following flexible working patterns:
Working flexible hours - from 7am-4pm or from 8am-5pm.
Location: Curitiba, PR.
Working with us
Our people are at the heart of what we do at Baker Hughes. We know we are better when all of our people are developed, engaged and able to bring their whole authentic selves to work. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.
Working for you
Our inventions have revolutionized energy for over a century. But to keep going forward tomorrow, we know we have to push the boundaries today. We prioritize rewarding those who embrace change with a package that reflects how much we value their input. Join us, and you can expect:
Contemporary work-life balance policies and wellbeing activities
Comprehensive private medical care options
Safety net of life insurance and disability programs
Tailored financial programs
Additional elected or voluntary benefits
The Baker Hughes internal title for this role is: Quality Senior Specialist - QA Engineering
About Us:
We are an energy technology company that provides solutions to energy and industrial customers worldwide. Built on a century of experience and conducting business in over 120 countries, our innovative technologies and services are taking energy forward – making it safer, cleaner and more efficient for people and the planet.
Join Us:
Are you seeking an opportunity to make a real difference in a company that values innovation and progress? Join us and become part of a team of people who will challenge and inspire you Let's come together and take energy forward.

title: Corporativo Supervisor de Treinamento
description:
Prazer, somos o maior grupo de food service genuinamente brasileiro Nos conectamos com as pessoas por meio das comidas e das histórias vividas na mesa. O nosso universo conta com 5 marcas, mais de 600 lojas, 2 centrais de produção, 6 centros de distribuições e 1 contact center. Essa variedade de negócios nos permite estar presente no dia a dia e fazer parte da vida de milhares de pessoas, há mais de 40 anos. Nossas 10 mil pessoas se desenvolvem junto com a nossa história, conectando seus desejos com os nossos, para criar momentos inesquecíveis e experiências que facilitam e marcam a vida de cada um. Se você tem o desejo de #fazertudodarcerto, prepare-se para se apaixonar Desafio:Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Treinamento do Varejo para atuar com um portfólio de lojas em várias regiões do Brasil, incluindo Rio de Janeiro, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste, atendendo tanto lojas franqueadas quanto próprias de diversas marcas. O profissional será responsável por gerir e acompanhar as operações do dia a dia, implementando e monitorando processos de treinamento, desenvolvimento e performance das equipes de vendas e operações, sempre visando excelência no atendimento ao cliente e no desempenho comercial. Principais Responsabilidades:Coordenar e executar treinamentos para as equipes de vendas e operação em lojas franqueadas e próprias. Realizar gestão do time de Instrutores de Treinamento de cada região. Acompanhar o desempenho das lojas em diversas regiões (RJ, Nordeste e Centro-Oeste), garantindo a implementação e execução dos programas de treinamento de forma eficiente. Realizar o acompanhamento e desenvolvimento contínuo das equipes, visando melhorar os resultados operacionais e o atendimento ao cliente. Elaborar, revisar e aplicar conteúdos de treinamentos específicos de acordo com as necessidades de cada marca e região. Monitorar indicadores de performance, como vendas, produtividade, e qualidade de atendimento, com base nos resultados dos treinamentos aplicados. Elaboração de relatórios e análises sobre a evolução dos treinamentos e impactos nas lojas. Gerir o treinamento e a capacitação a distância, mantendo uma comunicação eficiente e clara com as equipes, mesmo à distância. Ser um elo de comunicação entre as lojas e a liderança, promovendo um ambiente colaborativo e organizado. Garantir a aplicação de boas práticas operacionais e de atendimento nas lojas sob sua supervisão. Requisitos:Possuir ensino superior completo. Residir no Rio de Janeiro. Possuir veículo próprio. Possuir experiência com gestão de equipe. Possuir experiência com liderança em campo no varejo, preferencialmente no segmento alimentício. Fases do Processo:1 Triagem curricular e checagem de requisitos (reprobatório). 2 Envio de comprovante de Escolaridade 3 Entrevista com A&S. 4 Entrevista final com gestor da área. 5 Proposta Se você tem paixão por capacitar equipes e contribuir para a melhoria contínua do varejo, venha fazer parte desse time

title: Senior Forex Business Development Executive
description:
About DB Investing
DB Investing is a fast-growing, award winning global brokerage firm regulated by multiple international authorities. We have a globally recognized online trading platform offering clients access to the financial markets with advanced technology, client-centric services, and tailored investment solutions. With a solid presence in multiple jurisdictions and a strong commitment to transparency and innovation, we empower traders and partners alike to grow and succeed.
As part of our expansion strategy, we are seeking highly driven and experienced Senior Business Development Executives to join our elite team. If you have a solid background in Forex or financial institutions and come equipped with an active IB (Introducing Broker) portfolio, we want to hear from you.
Role Overview
The Senior Business Development Executive will play a critical role in acquiring and managing key partnerships, driving revenue growth through a high-value IB network, and expanding DB Investing's footprint in the global market.
Key Responsibilities
Portfolio Management: Leverage and bring your existing IB portfolio to DB Investing to generate immediate and long-term revenue.
Business Acquisition: Identify and onboard new IBs, affiliates, and institutional partners in target markets.
Relationship Building: Maintain strong, long-term relationships with partners, providing ongoing support and engagement strategies.
Revenue Growth: Work towards predefined sales targets and KPIs to drive consistent and scalable business growth.
Market Analysis: Stay informed of market trends, competitor activity, and regulatory changes to identify opportunities and threats.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with marketing, compliance, and operations teams to ensure smooth onboarding and service delivery.
Reporting: Provide timely and accurate sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance analysis to senior management.
Candidate Requirements
Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of proven experience in business development or sales within the Forex industry or financial services sector.
IB Network: Must possess a transferable and active IB Portfolio.
Industry Knowledge: In-depth understanding of FX, CFDs, trading platforms, and global financial market dynamics.
Sales Expertise: Strong track record of meeting or exceeding business development targets.
Soft Skills: Exceptional interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
Languages: Fluency in English is required; additional languages are considered an asset.
Work Ethic: Self-motivated, proactive, and able to work both independently and within a team structure.
What We Offer
Competitive Base Salary
Lucrative Performance-Based Commissions
Bonus Schemes & Incentives
Access to a Leading Trading Platform with Global Reach
Marketing & Operational Support to Grow Your Network
Dynamic, Diverse, and Supportive Work Environment
Why Join DB Investing?
Reputable and compliant broker with a strong brand in global markets.
Advanced technology and tools tailored for high-performing partners.
Transparent and fast onboarding process for IBs and partners.
Comprehensive partner portal and marketing kits to support your success.
How To Apply
If you meet the above criteria and are ready to take your business development career to the next level, we'd love to hear from you.
Send your CV and a brief portfolio introduction to:
Subject Line: Senior Business Development Executive – (Your Name)
Applications will be treated with the highest level of confidentiality. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Customer Support Analyst
description:
The Company You'll Join
Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta's platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence.
Carta's Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.
Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don't work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta's software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it's a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.
For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.
The Problems You'll Solve
In this role you will interact directly with Carta's client-base that is located in Europe. As their primary point of contact, you will address inbound requests/inquiries over emails. A successful candidate will be comfortable and confident in written and verbal communication with all of Carta's stakeholders including C-level executives, employees, law firms (partners and paralegals), as well as investors/board members. You will need to be able to learn quickly, execute smoothly, and intuitively solve problems.
Build strong customer relationships with customers while providing excellent customer support
Provide timely and accurate front-line support for all customers that your support segment services
Proactively follow-up with your clients and stay actively engaged from the day a case is opened
Proactively review customer case data to identify where customers can improve competency
Ensures proper adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs) across all channels
Prepares for, schedules, and conducts case review meetings and trainings with assigned customers
Takes on additional projects to drive product improvement, engages with product teams as necessary
Maintains a close relationship with Support leadership team to ensure alignment with overall Support goals
Reconciles cap table
Collect feedback on support cases to improve product functionality
Become an expert in our security and escalation practices
This role requires 3 days a week in office
The Team You'll Work With
We are looking for an individual to work alongside our Carta Europe Support team within our International Organization to help build the world's next great financial infrastructure company.
About You
Fluent in English - both written and verbal - to communicate effectively with EU-based clients
Care deeply, genuinely, and passionately about client services and the role it plays in making a customer-centric company successful
Comfortable learning quickly and taking on new challenges
Ability to articulate both technical software issues as well as address equity/finance/accounting related questions in a clear and concise manner
Highly organized with a strong attention to detail
Ability to establish and maintain relationships with power users
Possess a helpful and professional attitude with excellent verbal and written skills
Exhibit diplomacy, tact, and poise under pressure when working through customer issues as well as a strong sense of curiosity to solve problems
Experience in a fast paced, client facing environment is a plus
Experience learning new technologies, platforms, and systems is a plus

title: Analista de Planejamento Operacional
description:
ocê é o tipo de profissional que enxerga um evento como um grande sistema integrado e sente prazer em planejar cada detalhe para que tudo funcione com precisão?

Então essa vaga pode ser pra você.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Planejamento Operacional para atuar na inteligência estratégica de grandes operações, apoiando decisões, estruturando processos e garantindo excelência na execução.

Responsabilidades

Planejamento Estratégico Operacional:

Mapear necessidades de portarias, fluxos de público e definir o posicionamento tático de equipes e equipamentos.

Infraestrutura Técnica:

Planejar a distribuição de validações, dimensionar a necessidade de conectividade e garantir estabilidade de internet nas operações.

Gestão de Processos:

Criar checklists detalhados, estruturar a operação de ponta a ponta e gerenciar logins, acessos e sistemas.

Desenvolvimento de Pessoas:

Conduzir briefings e treinamentos para equipes de freelancers e apoiar o planejamento de crescimento do time de SAC.

Logística e Patrimônio:

Controlar inventário, acompanhar a movimentação de equipamentos e garantir a gestão eficiente dos ativos da empresa.

Qualificações

Formação: Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Marketing, Eventos ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Vivência sólida em logística, operações de serviços e, preferencialmente, gestão de projetos.

Perfil: Organização impecável, pensamento analítico, visão sistêmica e proatividade para resolver problemas complexos.

Ferramentas: Domínio de Pacote Office ou Google Workspace.

Se você gosta de operação bem planejada, processos claros e sente orgulho de ver tudo funcionando perfeitamente no dia do evento, queremos te conhecer.

title: Operador de Sala de Controle
description:
Important To make sure your application is considered, please submit it before the end of the day on ):

We encourage candidates to apply as soon as possible.
What does the job involve?
Reporta-se ao Supervisor de Produção, opera e monitora sistemas ICSS – separação de produção/processo, sistemas de utilidades, sistema de água produzida, injeção de água, sistema de gás combustível, geração de energia, segurança e sistema de detecção de incêndio e gás.
What will my tasks be?
Within This Position, Your Key Tasks Will Be To
Coordena atividades operacionais, como produção de óleo, compressão de gás, tratamento de gás e reinjeção, injeção de água e sistemas de vapor, a fim de garantir um processo e gerenciamento de energia seguros, otimizados e estáveis.
Executa tarefas não rotineiras como parte da equipe de produção (pigging, testes de poços, otimizações de planta, testes de produtos químicos, inicializações de poços).
Inicia e monitora as variáveis da planta de processo (pressão, nível, temperatura, vazão), colaborando com outras instalações da Equinor para garantir a estabilidade e otimização da planta de processo.
Opera a planta de processo de acordo com as especificações da planta e os parâmetros legais para a descarga de água.
Mantém controle total das permissões de trabalho em andamento. Controla e gerencia sistemas de inibição de segurança, bem como sistemas de incêndio e gás (F&G).
Identifica e relata as necessidades de manutenção dos sistemas da planta de processo e de segurança no SAP.
Lida com emergências, como parte da equipe de resposta a emergências.
Trabalha em estreita colaboração com o Técnico de Sistema em todas as questões relacionadas ao DCS/ICSS.
Here's What We Expect From You
At Equinor, there are some overall qualities we regard as essential. We want you to identify with the values that guide our decisions and help us succeed and grow: open, collaborative, courageous and caring. We expect you to make safety your priority and to contribute to our zero-harm culture. And for this specific position, we are also looking for:
Diploma nas áreas de mecânica, elétrica, eletrônica, química ou equivalente e obrigatorio.
Mínimo de 3 anos de experiência como Operador de Sala de Controle de Produção em Plataformas de Óleo e Gás, ou 5 anos em Refinarias ou Plantas de Processo Contínuo.
Boas habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita em português, e capacidade de entender documentação técnica em inglês.
Conhecimento de sistema de gestão de manutenção, preferencialmente SAP. Eficiente no uso de sistemas de computador de escritório.
Compreender e gerenciar riscos.
Experiência anterior com produção de energia em Ciclo Combinado, manuseio de vapor, compressão de gás, tratamento de gás e reinjeção, bem como árvore de natal molhada é um diferencial.
Experiência na operação do Sistema DCS Honeywell (FPSO Bacalhau) pode ser considerada uma vantagem.
Valoriza a cooperação e a colaboração aberta como formas essenciais de trabalho. Proativo por natureza, toma iniciativa e é capaz de trabalhar de forma independente quando necessário. Oferece e recebe feedback construtivo e é motivado pela melhoria contínua.
Ser um modelo de segurança, diversidade e inclusão.
What can we offer you?
We want you to have a rewarding and fulfilling work life. That's why we offer:
Not just a job - a career
In Equinor, your development begins on day one. You will build your competence through a wide range of learning activities while being empowered to build your career across multiple disciplines and geographies. Our internal job market allows a wide range of opportunities for development and growth within your own field, or even in other areas you find interesting and relevant.
Attractive rewards
We give you a comprehensive benefits package with a competitive salary, global parental leave, bonus scheme and pension plan.
Wellness and work-life balance
We care about and prioritise our employees' well-being. We know that for you to be the best version of yourself in the workplace, being able to collect your children, attend a class or simply enjoy social time can be invaluable. That's why we encourage you to make use of our flexible work arrangements wherever possible.
An inclusive culture
We believe embracing our differences makes us stronger. For us, true inclusion means being able to bring your whole self to work, and for you and everyone else to feel accepted and valued.
Equal opportunities for everyone
Equinor is an equal-opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions, which include hiring, promotion, transfer, demotion, termination, and training, without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, marital status, parental status, veteran status, or any other protected status.
As part of this commitment, reasonable adjustments will be made during the recruitment process for candidates with disabilities or long-term health conditions. If you have any specific requirements, please clarify this in your application and our team will be in contact to see how we can support your needs.
Important notes about the application process
We expect you to openly offer all relevant information about yourself during the recruitment process. Background checks are performed on all final candidates, and all permanent and temporary hires will be screened using relevant sanctions lists to ensure compliance with sanctions laws. When applying for a job in Norway you will be asked for information on affiliation to high-risk countries for a security assessment.
About Equinor
Equinor is an international energy company headquartered in Norway, energising the lives of 170 million people worldwide. Our ambition is to be a leading company in the energy transition and achieve net zero by 2050. Our task is enormous: supplying the world with the energy it needs, while lowering emissions to the atmosphere. To achieve it, we are looking for like-minded people to join our team of 25,000 colleagues working in more than 20 countries. We're up for the challenge. Are you?

title: analista de importação e exportação jr
description:
Sobre a DHL
A empresa de logística para o mundo Conectando Pessoas. Melhorando Vidas. Nossas divisões especializadas da DHL oferecem um portfólio incomparável de serviços e soluções de logística que vão desde a entrega de encomendas nacionais e internacionais e remessas de e-commerce até serviços de fretes aéreos, marítimos e rodoviários e gestão de cadeias de suprimentos, do início ao fim. Com mais de 400 mil colaboradores, em mais de 220 países e territórios em todo o mundo, a DHL conecta pessoas e empresas de forma segura e confiável, permitindo fluxos de negócios globais globais. Certificados como Great Place to Work desde 2022, nós convidamos você a fazer parte da nossa máquina amarela

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Importação e Exportação engajado que, alinhado com nossa missão e valores, administre planos e processos de importação e exportação, assegurando a preparação e liberação da documentação junto aos órgãos competentes, além de orientar e aconselhar os clientes sobre operações e regulamentações de comércio exterior, em conformidade com a estratégia e os objetivos do negócio, bem como com as diretrizes e políticas corporativas.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  • Administrar planos e processos de importação e exportação visando a otimização dos serviços e do desempenho operacional.
  • Executar tarefas operacionais transacionais relacionadas à importação e exportação, em conformidade com as regulamentações e procedimentos internos.
  • Realizar registros de importação e exportação e apoiar as atividades operacionais, conforme os procedimentos internos e as regulamentações aduaneiras locais mais recentes.
  • Preparar cálculos de impostos, tarifas, conversão de preços, peso e volume das mercadorias importadas ou exportadas de/para destinos internacionais.
  • Elaborar, distribuir e arquivar toda a documentação necessária para importação e exportação.
  • Verificar faturas e documentos de embarque para garantir conformidade com as regulamentações federais.
  • Validar registros para assegurar o atendimento aos requisitos dos clientes e sugerir ações corretivas rotineiras em caso de desvios.
  • Garantir que as operações de exportação, importação e entrepostos estejam alinhadas às diretrizes do negócio e em conformidade com as expectativas estabelecidas.
  • Gerenciar atividades relacionadas aos sistemas de TI para manter as informações de remessas atualizadas.
  • Colaborar com áreas internas como atendimento ao cliente, produto, vendas, entre outras.
  • Comunicar-se com escritórios no exterior para checagem e validação de informações das remessas.
  • Resolver problemas recorrentes e sugerir melhorias nos métodos de trabalho de importação e exportação, com foco em aumento de eficácia e eficiência.

Local de Trabalho:
Híbrido – Rio de Janeiro RJ

Nós lhe propomos:

  • Fazer parte de uma empresa global, líder de mercado.
  • Faça parte de um time com expertise nestes segmentos que amam o que fazem
  • Oportunidades e plano de desenvolvimento.
  • Um clima de trabalho onde você possa ser você mesmo
  • Compartilhe e aprenda em equipe, com troca de informações e conhecimentos.
  • Torne-se o seu melhor, dentro de uma cultura construída com base na abertura, confiança e respeito mútuo.
  • PLR, Previdência Privada, Day Off no Aniversário, Plano de Saúde (Sul América), Plano Odontológico, Vale Refeição e/ou Alimentação, Auxílio Creche, entre outros.

Venha fazer parte da máquina amarela Uma multinacional que se destaca pelos seus compromissos e iniciativas globais de responsabilidade social e metas ambientais. Através do nosso Programa de Diversidade & Inclusão, ganhamos para promover uma cultura mais inclusiva, valorizando todos os profissionais e acreditando no potencial de cada um.

title: Bolsista de Mestrado em Comunicação
description:
Projeto:
 Estruturação do Laboratório DestinoLab – um laboratório de Testes de Tecnologias para o Turismo Inteligente no Município de Paraty (RJ) Duração da Bolsa: 12 meses

A bolsa de mestrado está vinculada a projeto desenvolvido pela Embratur, em parceria com o Parque Tecnológico da UFRJ, voltado à estruturação, implementação e acompanhamento de um piloto de experimentação tecnológica no município de Paraty (RJ).

O projeto envolve atividades de diagnóstico territorial, escuta ativa de atores locais, seleção e acompanhamento de soluções tecnológicas, realização de testes-piloto em ambiente real e consolidação de resultados. As soluções testadas abrangem temas como inovação aplicada ao turismo, sustentabilidade, governança de dados, experiência do visitante, mobilidade, acessibilidade, empreendedorismo local e promoção do destino.

O bolsista de comunicação atuará de forma transversal ao projeto, sendo responsável pelo planejamento e execução das ações de comunicação, divulgação institucional, produção de conteúdos e cobertura das atividades, contribuindo para a visibilidade do DestinoLab, o engajamento dos atores envolvidos e a disseminação dos resultados do projeto, com potencial de replicação em outros destinos turísticos nacionais.

Requisitos

  • Estar matriculado como mestrando(a) na Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro (UFRJ), preferencialmente em Comunicação, Jornalismo, Relações Públicas, Estudos de Mídia ou áreas afins
  • Ter disponibilidade para atuar nos 12 meses do projeto
  • Disponibilidade, em comum acordo com o orientador, para dedicar 20 horas presenciais por semana ao projeto. As atividades presenciais acontecem no Parque Tecnológico da UFRJ;
  • Excelente comunicação oral e escrita;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma colaborativa em equipe multidisciplinar.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia em comunicação institucional, projetos de inovação, políticas públicas, turismo, cultura ou desenvolvimento territorial.
  • Experiência na produção de textos para divulgação, redes sociais, releases, relatórios ou sites institucionais.
  • Noções de cobertura de eventos, entrevistas e produção de conteúdo audiovisual (texto, foto ou vídeo).
  • Disponibilidade para viagens pontuais. As viagens são custeadas pelo Parque Tecnológico da UFRJ.

Responsabilidades

  • Planejamento e execução das ações de comunicação e divulgação do projeto DestinoLab;
  • Produção de textos institucionais, notícias, releases, conteúdos para redes sociais e outros materiais de divulgação;
  • Cobertura das ações, eventos, oficinas, reuniões e testes-piloto do projeto;
  • Apoio à divulgação do edital de chamamento público e das soluções selecionadas;
  • Articulação com a equipe do projeto para levantamento de informações, entrevistas e registro das atividades;
